sources.excerpt: Germanium Preamp Pedal — BENSON AMPS Amplifiers Guitar Amplifiers Bass Amplifiers Tube Effects Speaker Cabinets Babylon Pedals Guitar Pedals Benson The Amp Finishes Extras Plugins Merch Benson Speakers INFORMATION Ordering Information Dealers Warranty Amplifier Care Contact Amplifiers Guitar Amplifiers Bass Amplifiers Tube Effects Speaker Cabinets Babylon Pedals Guitar Pedals Benson The Amp Finishes Extras Plugins Merch Benson Speakers INFORMATION Ordering Information Dealers Warranty Amplifier Care Contact Germanium Preamp Pedal Our classic preamp with a germanium twist ← Back to Guitar Pedals Germanium Preamp Pedal Germanium Preamp Pedal $259.00 Our classic preamp with a germanium twist Quantity: Add To Cart This pedal is based on our now famous amp-in-a-box Preamp pedal with one important tweak: the replacement of the first FET transistor with a germanium gain stage - stolen from our servo-biased Germanium Boost pedal which is ideal as a versatile gain stage since it reliably imparts a germanium tonality, mostly doesn’t care about temperature, and doesn’t affect frequency response. The result is an alternate universe take on our flagship pedal that marries the incomparable feel of the germanium with the careful equalization and tone controls of the preamp pedal. The result is a slightly lower gain, but richer sounding and feeling overdrive/boost/fuzz/whatever we really, really dig. We hope you like it! Beware : Germanium stops passing music at 120 Degrees Farenheit (like a very hot stage) Power Requirements: 9VDC Boss style adapter or battery 50ma Controls: Gain (distortion) Treble (low pass filter) Bass (high pass filter) Volume Content Link Block Select a page and create a visual link to it. Learn more Guitar Pedals Back to All Previous Next Top - **Archive parent:** Germanium Preamp Pedal - **Builder:** Benson Amps - **Catalog type:** Overdrive / Fuzz / Preamp - **Identity:** Benson Preamp platform with its first FET gain stage replaced by a Germanium stage derived from the Germanium Boost design. [1][2] - **GAIN** - **TREBLE** - **BASS** - **VOLUME** [1] - Retains the basic Benson Preamp control/EQ platform. - First FET gain stage is replaced by a **Germanium** gain stage. - The result is slightly lower gain but a richer/harmonic response than the standard FET Preamp. [1] - **Technology:** Germanium first gain stage. - Exact Germanium transistor part number is not publicly documented. - Exact clipping/protection diode type and part number are not publicly documented. - **9V DC center-negative or 9V battery**. - Approximately **50 mA** draw. [1] - Distinct Germanium Preamp model, not merely a finish change to the standard Preamp. - No numbered electronic revision established. Benson positions the Germanium Preamp as a slightly lower-gain but richer-feeling alternative to the standard Preamp. The Bass/Treble controls preserve the broad amp-like shaping of the platform while the Germanium first stage changes the gain texture.
